ownerChoices: Membership: the route's nested source may be omitted only for the earlier c_call_result_admitted event by admission ordinal with the same runId, basisId, graphCallId and frameId; aggregateType c_call, aggregateId and payload.cCallRef equal to route.payload.cCallRef; resultClass success; payload.value canonically equal to the source. This matches worksite_input_provenance's retained-input projection.

No causation requirement: the RC3-era captured route 37961 does not list its Result as a cause, and the partial's causation-based test would never have encoded it. Membership stays the authorizing relation; the current runtime does list the Result as a cause (traversal_route.ts) and the installed case asserts it.

Encoder uniqueness is producer policy over the existing aggregate:c_call index plus staged batch events: exactly one member or stay inline. The decoder checks only the named member, so full, selected and descriptor readers agree. c_call.ts already refuses more than one Result per CCall.
Size check precedes body acquisition. A reference that is not smaller, an unavailable source or an unequal value stays inline.

The Result's own body is acquired through the existing durable owner (history.event / inline-body reader), whether the Result is inline or itself v1-referenced. There is no new store, sidecar, stream, service, registry, Public schema, controller or constructor.

codecVersion 3 reuses the four existing bodyReference keys with sourceSlot c_call_result_value. Legacy, v1 and v2 histories stay readable. Older readers do not read v3; this is disclosed in design and in the claim.

The installed fixture references the ABI-owned retained contract but never declares it. The contract helper skips T so that WORKSITE_COMMAND_EXECUTION alone owns it, as execution_resolution exactAbiOwner requires. The binding is serialized as data from basis.product.graphInputRetentionBinding into program.mjs, so program.mjs gains no pre-install import. leaf.mjs imports isRetainedGraphInput from the installed ABI package.
